desc:
🎮 Welcome to this map! 
Experience RP, practice, and complete missions with friends.
Live in a world of training, developing skills, and participating in various activities within the department.

✨ Things you can do.
• Participate in training and promotion exams.
• Participate in various activities and missions.
• Drive a vehicle
• Join a unit and build a team.

📢 The game is in development. 
If you find a bug or have feedback, you can report it to the team at any time.

🙏 Thank you to everyone who played and supported our game. Have fun with your adventures and training!
